decisions.statement: The kind of page is read from the path rather than from the index.
A path the naming grammar reads as no page file is refused.
A page that is no page type is refused here.
The refusal for a page that is no page type names the change renaming a page.
A page type is handed to the partial change renaming a page type.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: one page type renamed, by the partial change renaming a page type
